results.message: Can I open a bike by pointing my phone camera at its square code?
Stop charging by the minute after someone has parked the cycle.
Show me where I can pick up a bicycle, and how many are waiting there.
Let visitors buy a 24-hour riding ticket using a payment card.
A broken brake should be easy to flag from the app.
If no empty stand is left, allow the rider to end the trip beside the station.
Use an email address instead of a mobile number to create a rider profile.
The bicycle company should sponsor a weekend road race.
Could the app time each outing and bill it when the bike is returned?
Maybe use the station map to show nearby drinking fountains too.
Let visitors find pieces from the Bronze Age even if they do not know the artist.
Before an artifact leaves for a partner museum, require management approval and record its insurance amount.
We should stop showing the previous owners of an object to curators.
Take a picture of a cracked vase and log the repair after conservation.
Could the exhibit card include a spoken description?
When an item moves from one shelf to another, retain where it used to be.
A curator must not approve their own access to finance records.
Send the monthly acquisitions file as a spreadsheet rather than CSV.
The museum's café should use reusable cups with paintings on them.
If an object is newly acquired, photograph it, assess its condition, and place it in storage.
Do not invite volunteers into the trial before the ethics committee signs off.
Let the PI move money between travel and equipment lines after an award.
Can a student book the microscope for tomorrow and see whether it is due for maintenance?
The lab manager should know which freezer holds specimen S-104.
Require a safety course before granting entry to the restricted lab.
The funder wants progress updates twice a year, not every quarter.
Publish the study paper immediately rather than waiting for its release date.
When the project ends, reconcile spending, file the final funder update, and close the award.
The university football team wants a new jersey sponsor.
Maybe use a chat room for researchers to discuss their papers.

limitations: Batch embedding time includes model load and is not a per-request production latency measurement.
